This project makes remote full-featured access practical today:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What the script does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. **Patches the dsh privileged-methods fence** (one line) so trusted hosts are allowed instead of l"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"oopback-only. Idempotent, keeps a `.bak` backup.
2. **Installs the official Caddy** (apt or direct b"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"inary download; `GH_PROXY` mirror variable supported for CN networks) and writes a Caddyfile with **"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"bcrypt basic auth** that reverse-proxies to the loopback dsh server.
3. **Installs a systemd user se"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"rvice** for the auth proxy (auto-start, crash-restart, journald logs).
4. **Prints the Tailscale Ser"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ve command** and access URL."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Quickstart"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Open `https://<machine-name>.<tailnet>.ts.net` — a password prompt appears, and the **full** dsh UI "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"(settings, agent presets, credentials, model discovery included) works remotely."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> If `dsh web` runs through a reverse proxy / Tailscale Serve, the browser origin is a real hostname"},{"id":"p11s2","text":", so the dsh server must be started with
> `dsh web --trusted-host <hostname>` (and the same value p"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"assed to the script via `--trusted-host`)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Options"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Flag | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `--password <pw>` | — | password for the auth layer (required) |
| `--user <name>` | `dsh` | auth "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"username |
| `--dsh-port <port>` | `3080` | dsh web listen port |
| `--caddy-port <port>` | `3081` |"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" auth proxy listen port |
| `--trusted-host <h>` | — | repeatable; hostnames allowed to drive dsh |
"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"| `--dry-run` | off | print actions without changing anything |
| `--skip-patch` | off | do not touc"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"h the dsh core patch |
| `--skip-caddy` | off | assume caddy is already installed |
| `GH_PROXY` (en"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"v) | — | mirror prefix for the caddy download, e.g. `https://ghfast.top/` |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Why not a plugin?"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Two of the three moving parts cannot live inside the dsh plugin system:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Caddy** is a separate process (a reverse proxy) — dsh plugins only run inside the dsh process.
-"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" **The privileged-methods fence** is hardcoded in `dsh-client-connection` (a module-private closure)"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"; a plugin cannot bypass it from the outside, and the webserver route registry does not allow interc"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"epting `/api` ahead of the built-in route."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The `--trusted-host` flag itself is official dsh functionality. This script simply assembles the pie"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"`--trusted-host` flag itself is official dsh functionality. This script simply assembles the pieces."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"> ⚠️ The dsh web UI can execute arbitrary commands on the host. Anyone with the password can drive i"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"⚠️ The dsh web UI can execute arbitrary commands on the host. Anyone with the password can drive it."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- The dsh server must stay bound to **loopback** — the Caddy proxy is the only public entry.
- The p"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"assword is stored as a **bcrypt hash** only (in `~/.local/share/dsh-remote-access/Caddyfile`).
- Use"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" a **strong, unique password**. Over Tailscale the traffic is encrypted end-to-end and constrained t"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"o your tailnet.
- This is a stopgap: the dsh project plans a real authentication layer. When it ship"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"s, drop the patch + proxy and use the official auth."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
